Population.evidence_source: Semi-structured interview and focus group schedules consisting of open-ended questions explored participants' experiences with suicide attempts in men, including factors contributing to a suicide attempt, as well as perceived barriers to preventing suicide.

Type.evidence_source: All interviews and focus group discussions were conducted by a male member of the research team (MP) and lasted 45-70 and 60-90 minutes, respectively. With consent from participants, they were recorded and transcribed verbatim.

Area.evidence_source: Semi-structured interview and focus group schedules consisting of open-ended questions explored participants' experiences with suicide attempts in men, including factors contributing to a suicide attempt, as well as perceived barriers to preventing suicide.
